create_ExecutionTrace: create an ExecutionTrace object from a JSON-loaded execution trace dictionary
validate_ExecutionTrace_with_TraceValida: validate an ExecutionTrace object using TraceValidator and assert it passes validation
run_TraceValidator_validate: run the validate method on a TraceValidator instance to check trace integrity
count_ops_with_num_ops: count the total number of operations in a validated execution trace using num_ops
count_comm_ops_with_num_comm_ops: count the number of communication operations in a validated execution trace using num_comm_ops
